name: Weather
description: A multivariate time-series forecasting benchmark derived from local climatological data. The ETT benchmark family comprises four subsets: ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1, and ETTm2. This record describes the Weather dataset and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Wu, H., Xu, J., Wang, J., and Long, M. (2021). Autoformer: Decomposition Transformers with Auto-Correlation for Long-Term Series Forecasting. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34 (NeurIPS 2021). https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.13008
